description: Defines the QuicBatchWriterBase class, a base class for batch writers in the QUIC protocol implementation, including methods for writing packets, batching logic, and flushing buffered writes.

classes.name: QuicBatchWriterBase
classes.description: Base class implementing common logic for batch writers, including packet writing, batching, and flushing.

classes.name: QuicUdpBatchWriter
classes.description: Derived class implementing batch writing over UDP socket.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Handles writing a packet, managing write blockage and buffering.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered writes by calling the implementation-specific FlushImpl.

methods.name: GetReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the release time for packet sending; unsupported in base class.

methods.name: CanBatch
methods.description: Determines if a new write can be batched with existing buffered writes.

methods.name: FlushImpl
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented by derived classes to perform actual flushing.
